problem_statement: The devicetree API cannot resolve a child node identifier from a parent node using the child's integer unit address. Given a parent node and an integer unit address (for example 10 for a child named child@a), there is no macro that yields the node identifier of the matching child, nor an instance-number variant. As a result, code that needs to look up a child by its unit address must instead iterate over every child and compare reg addresses, which does not compose well with other macro loops. The devicetree API should provide a way to obtain a child node identifier from a parent node and an integer unit address, and an instance-number variant of the same, such that DT_PROP() over the resolved child returns that child's properties.
